prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 16-frame WILDLIFE animation sprite atlas for a Dragon Ball classic-era overhead RPG for teens/adults.
Input image is ONLY the existing map's style, sun direction and overhead camera reference. Do not redraw or include the map.
ART DIRECTION: adventurous martial-arts shonen, untamed wilderness, imposing wild animals with serious natural expressions. Dinosaur designs recall the dangerous enormous dinosaurs encountered by Goku in the original Dragon Ball series. Detailed reptilian scales, heavy muscular hindquarters, alert narrow eyes, believable necks and tails. NO anthropomorphic smile, no huge baby eyes, no rounded toddler proportions, no toy, mascot, kawaii, cute or preschool art. Keep readable clean cel-shaded DS/16-bit RPG illustration with warm dark outlines, not realism or horror.
EXACT LAYOUT: FOUR columns by FOUR rows, every cell ONE isolated complete creature; each row FOUR poses of the SAME creature with identical proportions/colors, facing RIGHT. Equal cell spacing and 15% transparent padding around every silhouette. All tails, wings, feet and heads wholly inside individual cells. Genuine transparent alpha background, nothing else. No colored or gradient background, ground, scenery, shadow, grid, labels or watermark.
ROW 1: massive classic Dragon Ball teal-green SAUROPOD, long robust neck, small angular reptilian head with narrow alert eye and closed mouth, deep green mottled back, pale ochre underside, long tapering tail, exactly four thick weight-bearing legs. It is a wild herbivore, reserved and watchful, never smiling. Four slow walking frames alternating feet and neck sway. Full body three-quarter overhead view; muscular mature animal.
ROW 2: ferocious Dragon Ball ochre/olive TYRANNOSAUR, low brow over small intense eye, angular broad snout, strong visible jaw with sharp triangular teeth, ridged scaled back, cream belly, exactly two enormous muscular legs with three correctly oriented clawed toes and two short forearms, long heavy counterbalancing tail. A powerful wild predator, not a comical baby. Four deliberate walking frames alternating left/right feet; natural athletic stance, tense closed or slightly open jaws, no human grin. Full body three-quarter overhead.
ROW 3: a natural white seabird, narrow focused dark eye, ivory feathers with blue-grey undersides and dark wingtip feathers, pointed ochre beak, not smiling. Side view flying right, four coherent wingbeat phases: raised, level, lowered, level. Anatomically intact pair of wings, compact natural body, all feathers inside cell.
ROW 4: Dragon Ball crested PTEROSAUR, leathery burnt-orange body and rust/ochre wing membranes, long sharp angular beak, swept-back pointed crest, narrow alert eye, two long membrane wings, two small taloned hind feet, slender tail. Wild prehistoric animal, no grin. Side view flying right, four coherent wingbeat phases with same body center and proportions; intact wings, no feathered dragon, no airplane.
Preserve each creature identity across frames. Mature proportions and wildlife behavior; dynamic and restrained. Both terrestrial rows use a consistent feet baseline. Flying rows use a consistent body center. Clean usable sprite atlas, not a poster.

prompts.purpose: Separate sprite bounds without clipping tails or wings
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is the edit target: the approved ADULT Dragon Ball wildlife atlas. Preserve every animal's species, mature proportions, narrow alert eyes, expressions, earthy colors, scaled anatomy, full bodies and the FOUR distinct animation poses per row. Keep transparent alpha.
CHANGE ONLY THE ATLAS PACKING: the current silhouettes intrude into neighboring columns, especially long tails and spread wings. Repack the same SIXTEEN full silhouettes into a strict 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS layout with equal-size cells and WIDE COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT GUTTERS. Each single animal silhouette should occupy NO MORE THAN 65% of its cell width and 75% of cell height, centered inside its own cell. All complete tails, necks, wing tips, feet and beaks must have at least 12% empty transparent margin from all cell edges. No part of ANY creature may enter another cell. Scale each row consistently while keeping each pose intact and unchanged. Preserve row order: sauropods, tyrannosaurs, seabirds, pterosaurs. Same 4 poses in every row. No visible grid, no labels, no background/gradient/color, no scenery, no shadows, no new animal, no cheerful/kawaii face or baby proportions. Only repair spacing and isolation for production-ready sprite extraction.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: TRANSPARENT NPC animation atlas for a Dragon Ball classic-era shonen RPG, mature adventurous art direction.
The input image is ONLY the map style, palette and overhead camera reference; never include the map or scenery.
Create exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, TWELVE complete full-body isolated sprites on genuine transparent alpha. Four animation frames of the SAME adult character on each row, all facing RIGHT in a mild 3/4 overhead view. Equal cells, at least 15% transparent internal margins, identical baseline and scale within a row, everything inside each cell. No gradients or background color, ground, shadow, grid, text or watermark.
Art direction: crisp 16-bit / Nintendo DS adventure cel shading, defined warm dark outlines, authentic Dragon Ball original series faces and clothing. NORMAL ADULT anime proportions, approximately five to six heads tall. Small natural eyes and serious or composed expressions, grounded purposeful movement. NO super-deformed/chibi giant heads, giant cute eyes, baby face, mascot, toy, preschool look or exaggerated smile. Match the existing map's warm natural daylight.
ROW 1: adult young BULMA, recognizably turquoise short ponytail with red tie, pink adventure dress with a belt over charcoal leggings, brown hiking boots, brown shoulder satchel. Focused traveler expression, closed mouth. FOUR different normal walking frames with opposed arm/leg motion; exactly two arms and two legs, intact boots and ponytail, same outfit and proportions throughout.
ROW 2: MASTER ROSHI / MESTRE KAME, wiry elderly adult, bald head, long white beard, red-rim sunglasses, muted orange tropical shirt, beige shorts, brown sandals. Holds one COMPLETE LONG WOODEN STAFF upright in his right hand in ALL FOUR frames, staff planted at same baseline. Four subtle standing idle frames with slight head turn, breathing and free left hand shifting; NO big exaggerated wave, no extra limbs, staff never disappears, NO turtle shell. Calm authoritative martial arts master, correct adult proportions.
ROW 3: adult background Dragon Ball village trader, normal sturdy adult build, orange work cap, faded green apron over cream rolled-sleeve shirt, brown trousers and sturdy boots. A small closed canvas supply sack hangs over the left shoulder. Neutral absorbed expression, closed mouth, normal small eyes. FOUR different walking frames, exactly two arms and two legs, natural alternating feet, consistent sack and hand grip, natural proportions.
Sprites should look like people going about their lives in an adventure RPG, not children's sticker characters. Stable clothing, identity and scale in every frame.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: TRANSPARENT foliage sway sprite animation atlas for a Dragon Ball DS-style overworld.
Input image 1 is only a style / camera reference for the hand-painted pixel-art Dragon Ball map. Do NOT include or redraw the island background.
ONE grid exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight isolated FULL TREES on genuine transparent alpha. Perspective slightly overhead three-quarter isometric as on the map. Match the reference's sunny greens, warm trunks, cel shaded painterly pixel-art foliage with crisp RPG silhouette. Each row the SAME tree, identical trunk roots baseline, FOUR coherent frames of a slow breeze moving just the canopy left, center, right, center. Roots and trunk base stay pinned at the exact same coordinate and size. Extremely subtle canopy sway about five degrees, no melting, bending the entire trunk or morphing leaves. No ground patches, grass, rocks, shadows, labels, grid marks, text, UI or watermark.
ROW 1: tropical island palm tree with curved warm brown trunk, large individual green feathered fronds as the Kame House beach palms, full trunk and all frond tips visible. Four stages of canopy breeze.
ROW 2: low round leafy tropical tree from the central forest, short sturdy ochre trunk, rounded umbrella canopy clustered in layered emerald and bright lime leaves. Four stages of foliage breeze.
Perfect even 4x2 grid, equal cell dimensions, 15%+ transparent padding inside every cell, all fronds and roots within bounds, no cropping or neighboring overlaps. Each pose shows exactly one entire tree. All four frames per row same overall scale and same root baseline. Beautiful integrated game-world decoration, not an icon or 3D render.
